title: Three phases from baseline to rollout plan
phase_2_activities: Identify candidate value pools from workflow and system evidence
Set measurable service and cost objectives
Shape the pilot solution and operating roles
Review tradeoffs and refine the candidate plan
phase_2_deliverables: Prioritized pilot opportunities with measures and owners
phase_1_activities: Workflows: demand, handoffs, exception paths, and cycle time
phase_3_activities: Compare pilot options by expected value, time to learn, and implementation effort
Develop roadmap with milestones, dependencies, owners, and support needs
Review the recommended sequence with decision makers
phase_3_deliverables: Agreed pilot sequence and decision gates
